state.description: The text to read and predict from. Must be non-empty unless images are sent. Text answers are spans of this string.

fields.description: Required. Map of field name to a typed field spec. At least one field; no upper limit. Fields that do not fit next to the state in one 8,192-token pass are split across parallel passes.

unit.description: Unit label. For durations, one of seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, years (default seconds).

decimals.description: Numbers, durations and number lists only.

min.description: Required for estimate/forecast: a number, or an ISO date for date estimates.

max.description: Required for estimate/forecast: a number, or an ISO date for date estimates.

step.description: Estimate grid: a positive number (days for date estimates), or "month" / "year".

null_threshold.description: Probability of null above which the value is null (default 0.5).

images.description: Optional embedded PNG, JPEG or WebP images placed before the state (max 4; 4 MiB each, 8 MiB total decoded; request body max 16 MiB). Remote URLs are not accepted.

reference_date.description: ISO date that anchors dates written without a year.

return_state_text.description: Return the text that spans index into.
